window: GSC US 16 months, GA US 18 months, master keyword list
findings: The site converts 0.9% of expected clicks at position 3-5. 66 queries sit top-10 with zero clicks, 20% of all impressions. That is AI Overview surface, not traffic you can win.
1,548 of 1,862 clicks come from 12 queries containing chatfin. Non-branded demand is 194 queries and 310 clicks in total.
1,147 pages get traffic Search Console cannot see
They have a GA row and no GSC row at all. The old plan read that as silence.
Ahrefs reached 37% of the site at every quality tier, and SILENT pages were the most reachable. That is a truncated crawl, not a link graph.
The ERP side earns 15 clicks, all on comparisons
rillet vs netsuite, netsuite vs rillet, rillet vs intuit. That is why every ERP gets an alternatives cluster.
blocked: 985 of ~1,540 rows on hand, so 931 live URLs. Roughly 555 refused pages are invisible.
Page one only, 242 paths. Nothing may be removed if it carries an external link, so this is the weakest point in the plan.
4 key events fire, all on the homepage. No content page can be judged on whether it converts.
25 rows on hand, ~1,800 live. The merges cannot ship without it.

waves.label: tree nodes, backlinked pages and earners. do first
sits on a term that earns clicks, or has real readers
weak signal. title and meta only, no body work
phantom impressions. confirm the query is real before spending
no signal. rewrite onto an intersection or fold under a cluster

frozen.reason: ChatFin is mentioned on other clients' pages for their DA. Editing the title or the copy risks breaking the mention that earned the link, so these take no write of any kind: not the title, not the meta, not the body.

protected.source: authoritative backlink export, 20 aug 2026, 349 rows over 211 referring domains
